packages.name: Now Playing
packages.description: Shows the song playing on your PC (Spotify, YouTube in a browser, any app that shows up in Windows' media controls): title, artist, time, a progress bar and an audio spectrum.
packages.author: Yuniverse

firmware.name: REVIVER v23
firmware.notes: Fixes the screen button going through screens in a jumbled order (and Back bouncing between two screens) after Now Playing or another package had been drawing: the drawing overwrote the keyboard's copy of your screen list. Everything from v22: your own screen list (Screens tab), a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, the image screen, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.
